transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with a deeply depressed mood, constant sadness, and a feeling of emptiness. It has been going on for over two years now—about two years and two months, actually. I just can't seem to shake this heavy feeling.
Have you had any period of feeling better that lasted more than two months since this started?
No, I don't think I've had any breaks like that. I really don't recall having any periods of feeling better that lasted for that long. It has just felt pretty constant the whole time.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Persistent Depressive Disorder, Major Depressive Disorder], but the patient describes a depressed mood that has persisted for over two years with no symptom-free interval longer than two months, which strongly supports Persistent Depressive Disorder. Major Depressive Disorder is less likely because its episodes are typically time-limited rather than continuously present for this duration.
